title: Crown of the Void
description: Giving new vibes to the End we all knows
body:
# Crown of the Void

A new era for The End.
Crown Of The Void expands the End with late-game progression built around Enderite—a rare End resource that lets you upgrade beyond Diamond and stand toe-to-toe with Netherite.

## Features

Enderite Ore & Debris
Naturally generates in the End as rare veins embedded in End Stone. Smelt/process it into Enderite Scrap, then craft Enderite Ingots.

Enderite Gear
Full toolset and armor: Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots, Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Hoe.

Smithing Upgrade
Use the Enderite Upgrade Smithing Template at a Smithing Table to upgrade your Diamond gear to Enderite—just like Netherite, but End-themed.

Balanced Endgame Tier
Designed as a late-game alternative to Netherite for End progression.

Localization
Ships with en_us, fr_fr, and pl_pl 

## World Generation

Enderite resources generate only in the End.

New worlds (or unexplored End chunks) are required to see the ore.
